components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Compact mint control for the next decisive action.
components.css: .ds-button { min-height: 38px; padding: 0 14px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 7px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 7px; font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "SF Pro Text", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; transition: color 160ms ease-out, background-color 160ms ease-out, border-color 160ms ease-out, transform 160ms ease-out; } .ds-button-primary { color: #07110d; background: var(--circuit); border-color: var(--circuit); } .ds-button-primary:hover { background: var(--circuit-dark); border-color: var(--circuit-dark); } .ds-button-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Transparent supporting action bounded by one cool-gray seam.
components.css: .ds-button { min-height: 38px; padding: 0 14px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 7px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "SF Pro Text", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; transition: color 160ms ease-out, background-color 160ms ease-out, border-color 160ms ease-out, transform 160ms ease-out; } .ds-button-secondary { color: var(--ink); background: transparent; border-color: #435157; } .ds-button-secondary:hover { color: var(--circuit-dark); background: #111a1f; border-color: #5a6a70; } .ds-button-secondary:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-button-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Dark compact field with mint focus and browser-autofill correction.
components.css: .ds-field { min-width: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 7px; color: var(--ink-soft); font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "SF Pro Text", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; } .ds-field input { width: 100%; height: 42px; padding: 0 11px; color: var(--ink); caret-color: var(--circuit); background: #0a1014; border: 1px solid #3a474d; border-radius: 7px; outline: none; font: inherit; transition: border-color 150ms ease-out, box-shadow 150ms ease-out; } .ds-field input::placeholder { color: #71807b; } .ds-field input:hover { border-color: #59686d; } .ds-field input:focus { border-color: var(--focus); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(75,204,153,.12); } .ds-field input:-webkit-autofill, .ds-field input:-webkit-autofill:hover, .ds-field input:-webkit-autofill:focus { -webkit-text-fill-color: var(--ink); caret-color: var(--circuit); box-shadow: 0 0 0 1000px #0a1014 inset, 0 0 0 3px rgba(75,204,153,.12); } .ds-field small { color: var(--muted); font-size: 11px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.45; }

components.name: Active Navigation Control
components.description: Unfilled current section located by one small mint square and brighter text.
components.html: <nav class="ds-nav" aria-label="个人控制台"><button class="ds-nav-item ds-nav-item-active" aria-current="page">用量</button><button class="ds-nav-item">访问 Key</button><button class="ds-nav-item">接入指南</button></nav>
components.css: .ds-nav { width: 190px; padding: 8px 14px; background: var(--ground-deep); } .ds-nav-item { width: 100%; min-height: 44px; margin: 1px 0; padding: 0 14px 0 32px; position: relative; color: var(--muted); background: transparent; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; display: flex; align-items: center; font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "SF Pro Text", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 650; cursor: pointer; } .ds-nav-item::before { content: ""; width: 6px; height: 6px; position: absolute; left: 13px; top: 50%; background: transparent; border-radius: 1px; transform: translateY(-50%); } .ds-nav-item:hover { color: var(--ink-soft); background: rgba(255,255,255,.025); } .ds-nav-item-active { color: var(--ink); } .ds-nav-item-active::before { background: var(--circuit); } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Usage Meter
components.description: Signature slim capacity line with one reduced-motion-safe reveal.
components.html: 本月已使用—登录后显示真实额度
components.css: .ds-usage { color: var(--ink); font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "SF Pro Text", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; display: grid; gap: 10px; } .ds-usage > span, .ds-usage > small { color: var(--muted); font-size: 12px; } .ds-usage strong { font-family: "SFMono-Regular", "Roboto Mono", Consolas, monospace; font-size: 48px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1; letter-spacing: -.035em; } .ds-meter { height: 7px; overflow: hidden; background: #263138; border-radius: 2px; } .ds-meter i { width: 0; height: 100%; display: block; background: var(--circuit); border-radius: 2px; transform-origin: left center; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference) { .ds-meter i { animation: ds-ledger-meter-fill 560ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1) both; } } @keyframes ds-ledger-meter-fill { from { clip-path: inset(0 100% 0 0); } to { clip-path: inset(0 0 0 0); } }

components.css: .ds-ledger { overflow: hidden; color: var(--ink); background: transparent; border: 0; border-top: 1px solid var(--line); font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "SF Pro Text", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; } .ds-ledger header { min-height: 68px; padding: 20px 0 15px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line-soft); display: flex; align-items: center; } .ds-ledger h2 { margin: 0 0 6px; font-size: 17px; font-weight: 650; } .ds-ledger p { margin: 0; color: var(--muted); font-size: 10px; } .ds-ledger-row { min-height: 49px; padding: 0 2px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line-soft); display: grid; grid-template-columns: 80px 1fr; align-items: center; gap: 12px; color: var(--ink-soft); font-size: 11px; } .ds-ledger-row:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,.025); } .ds-ledger-row code { color: var(--muted); font-family: "SFMono-Regular", "Roboto Mono", Consolas, monospace; }

components.css: .ds-pill { width: fit-content; padding: 3px 7px; color: var(--ink-soft); background: #253036; border-radius: 999px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "SF Pro Text", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; font-size: 9px; font-weight: 750; } .ds-pill i { width: 7px; height: 7px; background: var(--ok); border-radius: 50%; } .ds-pill-ok { color: #9ce8ca; background: #15382d; }

components.css: .ds-modal { width: min(520px, 100%); overflow: hidden; color: var(--ink); background: #11191e; border: 1px solid #415057; border-radius: 10px; box-shadow: 0 28px 72px rgba(0,0,0,.5); font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "SF Pro Text", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; } .ds-modal header { height: 60px; padding: 0 18px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; } .ds-modal h2 { margin: 0; font-size: 19px; } .ds-modal header button { width: 34px; height: 34px; color: var(--ink-soft); background: transparent; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 7px; font-size: 20px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-modal header button:hover { color: var(--circuit-dark); background: var(--circuit-soft); border-color: #285244; } .ds-modal header button:focus-visible, .ds-modal-action:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-modal-body { padding: 21px; display: grid; gap: 16px; } .ds-modal-body p { margin: 0; color: var(--muted); font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.6; } .ds-modal-action { min-height: 38px; padding: 0 14px; justify-self: end; color: #07110d; background: var(--circuit); border: 1px solid var(--circuit); border-radius: 7px; font: inherit; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; } .ds-modal-action:hover { background: var(--circuit-dark); border-color: var(--circuit-dark); }

narrative.overview:
Token Station is a quiet operational ledger on one continuous graphite canvas. Whitespace and hairline seams organize quota, routing, access keys, permissions, and audit metadata without turning the console into a card wall. Soft white copy carries the facts; one low-saturation mint signal shows the active path or the next decisive action.

The world is calm, compact, and factual. Authentication unlocks private values and actions, while signed-out views keep protected values visibly unknown rather than filling the interface with examples. Role boundaries, destructive consequences, and security facts remain explicit at the point of action.
keyCharacteristics: Deep graphite canvas with very small tonal steps between chrome and working regions.
Hairline seams, open sections, and generous horizontal breathing room instead of stacked cards.
One restrained mint signal for active location, capacity, focus, and decisive action.
Soft white hierarchy with monospaced type reserved for measured or machine-readable data.
Compact controls, explicit unknown states, and one reduced-motion-safe meter fill.

rules.name: The One Mint Signal Rule
rules.body: Mint is the only recurring accent and should remain visually rare: active location, primary action, capacity, focus, or live state only.

rules.name: The Unknown Remains Unknown Rule
rules.body: Protected values render as an em dash with a short login explanation; never substitute sample quotas, counts, permissions, or keys.

rules.name: The Semantic Exception Rule
rules.body: Amber warns and rose faults; both require a text label, icon, or state geometry so color is never the only carrier.

rules.name: The Data-Only Mono Rule
rules.body: Use monospaced type for figures, timestamps, keys, model aliases, request IDs, code, and telemetry only; human-facing navigation and explanatory Chinese stay in the system sans.

rules.name: The Ledger-Stays-Flat Rule
rules.body: Operational content remains flush with the canvas; physical lift belongs only to blocking tasks.

dos: Do keep quota, routing, key, permission, and audit facts on one continuous graphite canvas.
Do separate working regions with whitespace and hairline rules before adding a bounded container.
Do use mint sparingly for active location, decisive action, capacity, focus, and live state.
Do keep private signed-out values unknown and explain that login loads the real data.
Do preserve compact controls, readable contrast, dark autofill treatment, explicit security copy, and responsive horizontal navigation.
Do use monospaced type only for measured or machine-readable data.
donts: Don't reintroduce Matrix code rain, scanlines, neon glow, decorative grids, gradients, glass, or visual theatre.
Don't rebuild the workspace as a wall of floating cards or ambient shadows.
Don't fabricate quotas, counts, permissions, model names, keys, or operational status for signed-out or empty views.
Don't turn every label into terminal typography or uppercase telemetry.
Don't fill the active navigation row; the small mint square is the selected-state signature.
Don't add motion beyond the single quota-meter reveal and restrained control-state transitions.
